name: Bathyal-Spire

civilization.name: Vaerid Compact
civilization.notes: Nomad fleets riding the thermal belts, at war over every kilowatt of harvest.

description: Grass-plains and basalt shields alternate across the habitable belt, stitched together by towering mountain ranges. Farther poleward, past magnetic pole anomalies, the silence feels older than the soil.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Signal chatter rises from the inhabited zones, structured, rhythmic, and unmistakably deliberate.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls uranium controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
